Natural Earth 1:110m admin-0 country boundaries, public domain.

Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Natural Earth datasets are public domain. Boundaries are illustrative and do not represent an official position on territorial status.
LABEL_X / LABEL_Y are country cartographic label points, not employer locations.
Leaflet 1.9.4: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet ; BSD-2-Clause, see LEAFLET-LICENSE.txt.
Leaflet distributed files downloaded from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ .
All map assets are served locally; no third-party map tiles, geocoding, or user geolocation are requested.
